verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official MCP server that lets LLMs interact directly with its API and docs. It names supported clients (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop) for operating on an Appwrite project, and a hosted MCP server is bundled into its Claude Code and Codex plugins with one OAuth sign-in. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate reliably through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Appwrite offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows LLMs to directly interact with Appwrite's API and docs.
Using the MCP server, you can use applications such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and others to operate on your Appwrite project
The Appwrite plugins for Claude Code and Codex now include the hosted Appwrite MCP server, so your agent can work with your Appwrite project after one OAuth sign-in.
